newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips marginally higher, techs soft.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips marginally higher, techs soft.

text.p: The Dow Industrials made small advances in early trading on Monday while technology stocks eased as the market looked for direction ahead of this week's stream of crucial economic data.
The Dow Jones Industrial average rose around 11 points to 8124, while the Nasdaq composite slipped six points to 1564.

"The market is trying to find direction after its heavy run-up," Charles Payne, an analyst at Wall Street Strategies, said. "We've got a tremendous slate of economic data this week and there is a bit of anxiety creeping into the market."
The long bond was firm, up 7/32 to yield 6.44 percent.
